done_when: A repo lists tests every change must run in forge.toml's always_test, close runs them locally beside the picked tests, and this repo lists its rules, every-refusal and view-contract tests

findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 2
Raise: Not done
The new guide promises that close runs `always_test` on every change, but `src/forge/review.py:388-394` returns before invoking the pytest picker when a fix changes only `forge.toml`, docs, plans, Markdown, or Forge records. A fix that adds `always_test` to `forge.toml` therefore closes without running any listed test. The named proof at `tests/test_close_always_tests.py:64-76` covers only changes to test files, so it misses this path.
findings.title: Not done: close skips always_test for settings and docs changes

why: Close picks local tests by imports and mentions, so cross-cutting tests such as the rules and every-refusal checks fail only in CI, a round later
